visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a short beard and a grey baseball cap is standing in a hallway, carrying a small baby and a full yellow shopping basket. He attempts to open a door with a electronic lock, looking frustrated. The lighting is bright and indoor. (2) Close-up shots of a thumb pressing a sensor, followed by a macro shot of skin texture. The scene transitions to the same man wearing a black mask and a black cap in a workshop environment with tools visible in the background. (3) An animated graphic of a human palm showing blue veins is displayed. This is followed by shots of hands being washed under a faucet and a glass being rinsed in a kitchen sink. (4) The man is back in the hallway, demonstrating a new electronic lock. He shows the palm recognition feature by holding his hand up to the device. He points to the screens on both sides of the lock. (5) A screen recording shows a mobile app interface with a visitor notification. The man is then shown standing by the door, gesturing and talking directly to the camera for the sign-off.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a high-energy, upbeat electronic music track featuring a prominent synthesizer bassline. A male voice speaks rapidly and clearly, narrating the struggle of entering a house while holding a baby. A sharp 'ding' SFX marks the first emphasize point. (2) As the narrator explains the technical limitations of fingerprint locks, a mechanical clicking sound mimics the lock's failure. A smooth 'whoosh' transition SFX plays as the setting moves to a workshop. The BGM maintains a steady, driving rhythm throughout. (3) A digital 'beep' or notification chime sounds when the palm recognition feature is mentioned. The narrator's tone is highly confident. Water splashing sounds are heard clearly during the kitchen demonstration, overlapping with the constant BGM. (4) The final phase features a phone ringing sound effect during an app interface simulation. The narrator concludes with a high-arousal call to action, accompanied by a final musical stinger and the sound of a door clicking shut.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the 'Enbor' smart electronic lock by highlighting the frustrations of traditional fingerprint locks and demonstrating the superior palm vein recognition and dual-screen features of the new product.
